escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection RCE via AST Type Confusion
escalations.immediate_mitigation: npm audit fix in Source/Backend && Source/Frontend
escalations.guardians_task: Verify whether handlebars templates are ever compiled from user-controlled input in production code. If yes, treat as critical RCE.
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker injects arbitrary JavaScript through template compilation via AST type confusion or partial-block manipulation.

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection in Multipart Headers
escalations.guardians_task: Determine if form-data is called with user-controlled field names or filenames in any production request path.
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker uses user-controlled multipart field names to inject CRLF sequences into HTTP headers, enabling request smuggling.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search Route Not Mounted in app.ts
p1_findings.failure_scenario: GET /api/search returns 404. DependencyPicker typeahead returns no results. Users cannot link work-item blockers.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts, mount in app.ts with app.use('/api', searchRouter), confirm search tests pass.

p2_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md (69 FRs) Has Zero Source Coverage — Divergence Undocumented
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Developers consulting the primary spec are misled. Spec defines FeatureRequest/BugReport entities; source implements WorkItem domain. Onboarding and audits are unreliable.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add a 'Spec Authority' note to CLAUDE.md. Label FR-001..069 as Phase 2 in dev-workflow-platform.md, or confirm WorkItem domain as the canonical model.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001..010 (Tiered Merge Pipeline) Fully Unimplemented
p2_findings.failure_scenario: 10 requirements (risk classification, Playwright E2E generation, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge) are specified but produce no deliverable. Sprint gaps are silent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md and classify FR-TMP-* as Phase 2, or assign to TheATeam.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Only Checks Most-Recent Plan — 80+ FRs Invisible
p2_findings.failure_scenario: A coder ships without FR-dependency-* Verifies comments and the gate still passes. Regressions in dependency functionality are undetected.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add --all flag to run enforcer against every requirements.md under Plans/, or invoke it per-plan in CI.

p2_findings.title: FR-WF-013 (Observability) Has No Test Verifies Comment
p2_findings.failure_scenario: A change that silently disables logging or breaks the Prometheus registry passes the test gate. Observability regressions undetected.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-WF-013 to metrics.test.ts + assertions verifying GET /metrics returns 200 with metric counters.

p2_findings.title: Silent Error Swallow in api/client.ts:26 — Violates Architecture Rule
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Backend returns non-JSON body (e.g., proxy HTML error). Client silently returns {} to callers, discarding the actual error. Debugging becomes impossible.
p2_findings.recommendation: Replace catch(() => ({})) with catch(err => { logger.error('JSON parse failed', err); throw err; }) or add a justification comment if intentional.

p2_findings.title: js-yaml >=3.0.0 <3.15.2 — Quadratic CPU Exhaustion on Malformed YAML
uuid <11.1.1 — Buffer Bounds Check Missing (Direct Dependency)
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm install uuid@latest; cd Source/Frontend && npm install uuid@latest
p2_findings.effort: small (direct dep, may need API compatibility check)

p3_findings.title: Two eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps Suppressions Without Justification
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline justification comments or add missing deps to the dependency arrays.

p3_findings.title: @remix-run/router >=1.3.0 <1.23.3 — Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URL
